_what: Planning profile for the Boston MSIS->SWE triage mode. Contains program timeline assumptions only - no name, contact details, resume, or application history.

_sources.as_of: your-input: the date the run represents
_sources.opt_start: your-input: planned OPT start 2027-02-01, chosen inside the 60-day window (2026-12-23 to 2027-02-21) to delay the 90-day unemployment clock while keeping a buffer before the deadline. Any start in the window gives the same draws (tested).
_sources.stem_degree: your-input: confirmed by the student 2026-10-20 that the MS in Information Systems is STEM-designated (eligible for the 24-month STEM OPT extension)
_sources.commute_cities: your-input [DEFINE closed]: MA municipalities reachable from Northeastern (Boston) in about 60 min by MBTA subway, bus or commuter rail without a car
_sources.everify_overrides: your-input: set an employer to true ONLY with a dated E-Verify employer-search lookup recorded in the run log
_sources.program_end: your-input: MSIS program end 2026-12-23 (confirmed by the student 2026-10-20)
